card.title: 2026 Budget Implementation and Property Tax Rates
card.what_is_proposed: Implement 2026 municipal property tax rates, fees and related budget measures.
card.why: To fund municipal programs and capital priorities through property-tax and fee measures.
card.who_is_affected: Toronto property owners across all wards; this calculator is only for the residential class.

stages.quote: City Council adopted this item on February 10, 2026 with amendments.

conditions: Residential municipal rate is 0.614311% including City Building Fund and excluding education tax.
The demonstration assumes the same assessed value for both comparison years.

procedural_phrases.meaning_here: City Council adopted the budget implementation item after changes; use the enacted rate, not a preliminary recommendation.
procedural_phrases.quote: adopted this item on February 10, 2026 with amendments.

uncertainties: Actual bills may differ due to assessments, property tax classes, credits or other factors.
